review.why: Sets up, repairs or migrates Cloudflare Turnstile bot protection end to end: widget, frontend snippets, server-side verification and validation.
review.summary: A confirmed multi-step wizard: check authentication and scan the codebase, create the widget, embed it at chosen points for the user's framework, wire server-side verification in the existing backend, then validate. Scripts hold the deterministic API logic and the agent orchestrates and edits code. It has a separate flow when a widget already exists and framework references.
strengths: Strict credential rules: no unapproved executables for credential-bearing commands
Ends with a real validation pass before reporting success
cautions: Needs a Cloudflare account and API access
Bundled shell scripts and framework references are not read here
